simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲרָן (H765) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲרָן (ʼĂrân) means Aran , an Edomite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 42.

definitions.full: H765. Aran אֲרָן proper name, masculine a descendant of Esau (? Aramaic wild-goat ) Gen 36:28 = 1Chr 1:42 (see also דִּישָׁן ).
